name: Manual beatmatch nudge
lesson:
## Ride the pitch without sync

Sync off. Push B's tempo fader up a small, even amount over 4 bars, hold, bring it back to centre over 4, hold. The hand should move so slowly it looks still. Manual beatmatching is 10% ear and 90% not overcorrecting; this drill trains the 90%.

tracks.cue: A on its drum-machine intro, sync off; it sets the tempo.
Push B's tempo fader up a small even amount over 4 bars against A's kick, hold, bring it back.
